entry.name: mira.frame
entry.digest: Mirror your Max patcher on your iPad
entry.description: Mira.frame defines a rectangle in the Max patcher that will be mirrored on connected iPad devices. Any Mira-supported objects that fall within the rectangle will be visible on the iPad. Multiple mira.frame objects will be rendered on the iPad as separate tabs. When a mira.frame object exists in a patcher, all Mira-supported objects in the patcher are automatically assigned a scripting name.
